purpose: Non-Mundarica discovery metadata refresh for a Bangladesh government-hosted Munda-language digital archive. Deterministic reconciliation shows this record duplicates the canonical URL already registered as WEB-MUN-0032; it is preserved as an audit trail and is not a new unique source lead or audited identity.

records.title: Munda | Multiling Cloud digital archive
records.publisher: Multiling Cloud / Government of Bangladesh domain (bangla.gov.bd)
records.notes: The live resource labels the language Munda, lists Bangladesh locations, identifies a Community Contributors / Munda Field Recording section, and reports a Full Archive resource density of 860 with phonetic transcriptions and audio recordings. The same government-domain language-page URL was already registered as WEB-MUN-0032. This record is therefore a metadata refresh/alternate access manifestation, not a new unique discovery lead. The page does not establish equivalence with Indian Mundari [unr] or consent/reuse scope of individual recordings.
records.rights_note: The public page displays an all-rights-reserved notice. Public playback/index visibility is not treated as permission to redistribute recordings or transcriptions. Speaker consent, privacy/publicity, contributor authority, community validation and culturally appropriate secondary use remain unresolved.
records.scope_note: Potentially relevant Bangladesh Munda-language archive. Do not merge with Mundari [unr], Munda [unx], or any MLHKP language identity solely from the page label; taxonomy and collection documentation require independent reconciliation.

canonicalization.decision: Preserve WEB-MUN-0088 as a later metadata-refresh record only. It is deterministically duplicate to WEB-MUN-0032 and must not increase unique-lead, audited-identity, claim, evidence or provenance counts.
